name: Research Ethics
scope_by_subfield: {"meta-research": "Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles. An AI statement is mandatory in every submission, including an explicit statement of no AI use where applicable. Preprints are accepted but must not be updated during review; accepted work requires a final-publication link. The journal-specific AI statement requirement is stricter than Sage's general assistive-editing disclosure exemption."}
